reason: In the error/Alert branch, the old code showed Remove app whenever there was no delegationCredentialId. It now renders CredentialActionsDropdown (SelectedCalendarsSettingsWebWrapper.tsx:123-131), which hides Remove app when disableConnectionModification is true (CredentialActionsDropdown.tsx:68). The evidence overstates one point: line 182 passes the raw disableConnectionModification prop, not shouldDisableConnectionModification, so a disabled scope (isDisabled) alone does not hide the option.
